name: Bleu Bayou Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Bleu Bayou on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!
Bleu Bayou is a challenging shoot 'em up boss rush with rogue-lite elements, featuring the 8-bit aesthetic of your favorite handheld console.

Demo Features

  • Sling your trusty machete and rusty harpoon with Breakout-inspired toss-catch mechanics!
  • Challenge 5+ bosses to fast-paced combat, or to unique non-combat minigames!
  • Rogue-lite progression system featuring 35+ unique upgrades! Your build is in your hands!
  • Hone your machete, electrify your harpoon, or punish your foes with status effects like Poison, Slow, and Bleed. Grow your upgrade pool even more across subsequent runs!
  • Manage your debts wisely as you fight to stay afloat in the Bayou's harsh, predatory economy!
  • Test your skills in Time Attack mode to earn powerful rewards!
  • Meaningful player choice and multiple endings put you in control of your destiny!
  • Authentic 8-bit aesthetics, with dozens of unlockable color palettes!
  • Full controller support!

Full Version Features

  • More than 2x the number of bosses in the demo.
  • Over 100 upgrades.
  • A fully fleshed out casino.
  • Reasons to keep doing runs.
  • And much more!
